hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ "$f" == *.cpp || "$f" == *.h || "$f" == *.c || "$f" == *.hpp ]] && command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1 && clang-format -i "$f" 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ "$f" == *.nix ]] && command -v nixpkgs-fmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && nixpkgs-fmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true'

bash -c 'data=$(cat); f=$(echo "$data" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); new_str=$(echo "$data" | jq -r ".tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // empty"); if [[ "$f" == *.cpp || "$f" == *.h || "$f" == *.c ]] && echo "$new_str" | grep -q "#include <windows.h>"; then echo "Warning: new #include <windows.h> added to $f — is this intentional? Consider a Qt6 or POSIX alternative."; fi || true'
bash -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ "$f" == *flake.nix ]] && nix flake check 2>&1 | tail -5 || true'

bash -c 'data=$(cat); f=$(echo "$data" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); new_str=$(echo "$data" | jq -r ".tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // empty"); if [[ "$f" == *.cpp || "$f" == *.c || "$f" == *.h ]] && echo "$new_str" | grep -qE "\b(strcpy|strcat|sprintf|gets|strncpy)\b"; then echo "Warning: unsafe string function in $f — prefer snprintf, strlcpy, or std::string."; fi || true'
bash -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ "$f" == *flake.lock ]]; then echo "Blocked: update flake.lock via: nix flake update" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ "$f" == *.vcxproj || "$f" == *.sln || "$f" == *.vcproj ]]; then echo "Blocked: .vcxproj/.sln are legacy Windows build files. Add to CMakeLists.txt instead." >&2; exit 2; fi'
